{{short description|Italian statistician}}
'''Fabrizia Mealli''' (born 22 July 1966){{r|cv}} is an Italian statistician at the [[University of Florence]], known for her research on [[causal inference]], [[missing data]], and the statistics of [[employment]]. In 2013 she was named a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]].{{r|fasa}}

Mealli earned a [[laurea]] in economics from the University of Florence in 1990, and completed her Ph.D. in statistics at the same university in 1994.
After postdoctoral research at the [[University of Leicester]] she returned to Florence as a faculty member in statistics.{{r|cv}}
